title: A couple rescued two cat paintings from a skip; years later, the Louis Wain works sold for £16,000 
summary_full: While out walking their dog years back, a couple stumbled upon two cat paintings discarded in a skip. Little did they know the treasures they had rescued were linked to the famous artist Louis Wain. Their curiosity led to valuable research, and upon authentication, these artworks fetched an impressive sum at auction. This story emphasizes how seemingly forgotten art can possess extraordinary worth.
